name: Scholarships, grants and paid training in the Bangsamoro
note: Programs the Bangsamoro Government runs for students, out-of-school youth and job-seekers, each traced to the official page it was read from. A status is given only where an official page states one.

programs.name: AHME College Assistance Program (AHME-CAP)
programs.office: Ministry of Basic, Higher and Technical Education
programs.summary: Yearly grant for college students from low-income families to help with tuition and school costs; 1,540 students were covered for school year 2026-2027.

status.note: No open call on an official page we can read; the office announces calls on its own pages and Facebook.

programs.name: Access to Higher and Modern Education Scholarship Program (AHME-SP)
programs.office: Ministry of Basic, Higher and Technical Education
programs.summary: College scholarship; for school year 2026-2027 each scholar gets PHP 40,000 per semester (PHP 80,000 a year). It prioritizes former combatants, their children, orphans and surviving spouses.
programs.how: Apply online through the AHME portal during the application window (the 7th cohort window, April 13 to May 13, 2026, is closed).

status.note: Applications for school year 2026–2027 (the 7th cohort) are closed; the online application form is marked not available.

programs.name: Bangsamoro Medical Scholarship Program (BMSP-TDIF)
programs.summary: Pays for students in medicine and other health courses at partner schools; scholars must return to serve their communities after graduating and passing the board exam.

status.note: No open call on an official page we can read; the office announces calls on its own pages and Facebook.

programs.name: Bangsamoro Assistance for Science Education (BASE) and BASE-Merit
programs.summary: College scholarships in science, technology, engineering and math for graduating senior high school students from BARMM.
programs.how: Pass the MOST scholarship exam, then apply online or at a MOST provincial office.

status.note: No open call on an official page we can read; the office announces calls on its own pages and Facebook.

programs.name: Bangsamoro International Graduate Study for Science and Technology (BIGAST)
programs.summary: Grants for Bangsamoro professionals to take graduate studies in advanced sciences abroad.

status.note: No open call on an official page we can read; the office announces calls on its own pages and Facebook.

programs.name: Bangsamoro Special Assistance for Science Education (BSASE)
programs.summary: Grants for enrolled college students in MOST priority science courses with at least 80% average, endorsed by a Member of Parliament.
programs.how: Submit the BSASE form with enrollment, grades, birth, indigency papers and an MP recommendation letter.

status.note: No open call on an official page we can read; the office announces calls on its own pages and Facebook.

programs.name: Mujahidin Assistance for Science Education (MASE)
programs.summary: Educational grants for children of MILF/MNLF combatants taking science and technology courses, funded by Members of Parliament.
programs.how: Submit the MASE form with enrollment, birth, unit-base and indigency certificates.

status.note: No open call on an official page we can read; the office announces calls on its own pages and Facebook.

programs.name: Professional Assistance for Science Education (PASE)
programs.summary: Graduate study grants in science and technology for BARMM professionals up to 50 years old.

status.note: No open call on an official page we can read; the office announces calls on its own pages and Facebook.

programs.name: Bangsamoro Scholarship Program for Technical-Vocational Education and Training (BSP-TVET)
programs.office: Ministry of Basic, Higher and Technical Education
programs.summary: Free tech-voc training in courses such as Cookery NC II, Carpentry NC II, Driving NC II and Computer System Servicing NC II, run by MBHTE-TESD.

status.note: No open call on an official page we can read; the office announces calls on its own pages and Facebook.

programs.name: Regional Manpower Development Center (RMDC) free skills training
programs.office: Ministry of Basic, Higher and Technical Education
programs.summary: Free tech-voc training for people aged 15 and up; trainees get a training certificate, a uniform, a PHP 180 daily allowance and referral to partner companies for on-the-job training.

status.note: No open call on an official page we can read; the office announces calls on its own pages and Facebook.

programs.name: Government Internship Program (GIP)
programs.summary: Three months of work in government for fresh college graduates, with a monthly stipend of 75% of the minimum wage from MOLE and 25% from the partner office; there are also Hay-Atul Ulama and Kulliyah GIP versions.

status.note: No open call on an official page we can read; the office announces calls on its own pages and Facebook.

programs.name: Special Program for the Employment of Students (SPES)
programs.summary: Summer jobs for high school students and out-of-school youth; MOLE pays 60% of the minimum wage as a stipend and the partner employer pays 40%.

status.note: No open call on an official page we can read; the office announces calls on its own pages and Facebook.
